signatures.description: QA chaos-errorpath probes on config-optional Go services: app loads defaults with no config file and serves normally (verified live: no-config start opened graph store, ingest queue ready, served /health). The missing-config->error premise is vacuous; error-path coverage must instead target malformed-config or explicitly-required config. Probe design lesson: verify a config is REQUIRED before writing a missing-config error-path cell.
